name: ADP-mk4 Core SecondWind
description:

Damage Reduction: 40%
Temp. Rating: -80 / 105 °C
Radiation Protection: 52800 REM
Radiation Scrub Rate: 251.1 REM/s
Carrying Capacity: 10.5K µSCU
Backpacks: All

When there's a difficult job at hand, you want to ensure that you can see it through to the end. Clark Defense Systems' ADP-mk4 heavy armor allows Marines to remain in active combat situations for a longer duration with more loadout options, while its powered frame provides near unfettered movement despite the protection it offers.

To honor those who came to Orison's aid in its time of need, the SecondWind edition compliments the armor with a rich blue base adorned with a sleek, flowing air design.
